meaning:
ἀστοχέω, -ῶ
(στόχος, a mark), [in LXX: Sir.7:19 8:9 * ;]
to miss the mark, fail: with genitive, 1Ti.1:6 (so in π., MM, see word); before περί, 1Ti.6:21, 2Ti.2:18.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,
men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.
